sittings.bodyEn: Do not invent a subway station. Do not invent commute minutes. Liangzhu is not next to Zijingang. Leave travel time unquoted.
sittings.mandarin: 地铁站和通勤分钟我都不编。良渚不挨着紫金港。通勤时间我不报。

sittings.bodyEn: Company name is 枫翎集团. Not 枫鱼. Not 顺坤. Stick to the post.
sittings.mandarin: 公司名是枫翎集团，不是枫鱼，也不是顺坤。

sittings.bodyEn: Do not invent patent counts, test-report counts, awards, FDA, funding rounds, amounts, or investors. If unverified, do not quote.
sittings.mandarin: 专利数量、检测报告数量、奖项、FDA、融资轮次、金额和投资人，我都不编。没核对的不报。

sittings.titleEn: No boss you have not met
sittings.bodyEn: Do not invent a boss name you have not met. Do not invent headcount. Do not invent your future manager’s name.
sittings.mandarin: 没见过的老板名字我不报。人数我不报。未来上级的名字我也不猜。

sittings.bodyEn: Do not invent visa type. Do not invent whether you can work full-time. Do not invent social insurance answers. Check documents later.
sittings.mandarin: 签证种类、能不能全职、社保，我今天都不猜。回去核对证件再说。

sittings.bodyEn: Do not invent any salary number not on the post. Do not say 15K. Do not say 8K just to please them. Stay with confirming what 8–12K means.
sittings.mandarin: 帖子以外的薪资数字我不报。不说15K，也不为了讨好说8K。只先确认8到12K是什么范围。

sittings.bodyEn: Do not say seven interviews are done. Do not say Jev is already live. Do not treat Integra 10 as staff. Do not invent WeUseAI revenue or a secretary team.
sittings.mandarin: 不说已经做完七家访谈。不说 Jev 已经上线。Integra 的10是客户不是人数。WeUseAI 营收和秘书团队我都不编。

sittings.titleEn: No language or China 总办 fiction
sittings.bodyEn: Do not claim Chinese fluent or native. Do not claim you have done 总办, official documents, PR copy, or government reception in China.
sittings.mandarin: 我不说中文流利或母语。我不说在中国做过总办、公文、公关稿或政府接待。

sittings.bodyEn: You are not coming to do AES R&D or rebuild their company AI system. Today’s role is assistant.
sittings.mandarin: 今天不是来做 AES 研发，也不是来改他们公司的 AI 系统。今天应的是助理。

sittings.bodyEn: Recall what you must not invent.
sittings.prompt: Which claim must you refuse today?
choices: Invented commute minutes, patent counts, funding amounts, visa type, or a salary not on the post
Saying company on the post is 枫翎集团
Saying you are near Zijingang and can do evenings or weekends
Asking what the assistant does each day
